paragraphs.text: Bookmark manager plugin for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar browser (dsh-plugin)
# dsh-browser-bookmarks
A DeepSeek Harness client plugin that adds an integrated bookmark manager to the right sidebar Brows
k Harness client plugin that adds an integrated bookmark manager to the right sidebar Browser panel.
## Overview
In DeepSeek Harness, the sidebar Browser lets you preview websites and test web interfaces alongside
your chat conversations. `dsh-browser-bookmarks` enriches this browser view by adding a star button
directly into the toolbar between the Reload button and the address bar.
Clicking the star opens a dropdown popover to save, organize, and navigate your favorite URLs with e
king the star opens a dropdown popover to save, organize, and navigate your favorite URLs with ease.
## Key Features
- **Native Toolbar Integration:** Placed seamlessly between the Reload button and URL bar, respectin

g the exact 28x28px tool styling and DSH theme variables (`--dsw-*`).
- **Dynamic Star Indicator:**
Turns active golden (`#eab308`) when the currently opened page is bookmarked; stays outline when it

is not.
- **One-Click Page Bookmarking:** Quickly bookmark or remove the current page with a single

click.
- **Custom Bookmarks:** Add bookmarks manually with custom titles and arbitrary URLs.
- **Ins

tant Navigation:** Click any bookmark in the list to immediately navigate to that address.
- **Full

Management:**
- **Reorder:** Move bookmarks up or down (▲ / ▼).
- **Inline Editing:** Edit bookmark

title and URL in place (✏️).
- **Delete:** Remove unwanted bookmarks (🗑️).
- **Persistent Storage:**

Stored locally in `localStorage` under `dsh:browser:bookmarks`.
- **Keyboard & Click-Outside Friend
ly:** Closes automatically on `Escape` or clicking outside the popover.
